events.n: Happy Hour w/ The Shaw Brothers at Woodlands Tavern
events.d: The Shaw Brothers have been performing their emotionally driven songs since 2005. The (actual) brothers combine elements of folk, soul, reggae, and American roots, creating a colorful pallet of their storied musical history. Blood harmonies, multi instrumental talent, and rich songwriting line the walls of every performance

Live entertainment offered on the Patio or in the Grotto on select nights. Please see Entertainment Calendar for scheduled dates. Please make note when making reservation if it’s for the entertainment.

events.n: Healthy New Albany Run / Walk Club
events.d: Healthy New Albany’s Wednesday Run/Walk Club is a casual, social way to get moving and connect with others during the week. Meet at Elliot’s Wood Fired Kitchen & Tap, head out for a run or walk, and gather back at Elliot’s afterward. All paces are welcome, whether you’re looking to log a few miles, meet new people, or simply enjoy an active evening out. No registration is required. Just show up and join us!
